Description: Picard iteration may not converge for nonlinear SSA with strongly non-uniform viscosity near shear margins
Mitigation_Status: 0.6] under-relaxation; fallback to 10-iteration limit with halved Delta_t; flag non-convergent timesteps
Resolution_Phase: Mitigation specified (Phase 5.2.2.4); empirical criteria established; convergence guarantee formally revoked

Description: Glen rate factor A temperature-dependence may produce singular viscosity at the ice divide where du/dx -> 0
Likelihood: Medium — occurs at divide in every flowline
Mitigation_Specified: Kelvin regularisation: replace |du/dx| with sqrt((du/dx)^2 + epsilon_reg^2); epsilon_reg = 1e-15 s^-1

Description: Variable-width finite-volume formulation may produce spurious flux divergence at width-change nodes
Likelihood: Medium — occurs at all significant width transitions
Mitigation_Specified: Use harmonic-mean face width: W_{i+1/2} = 2*W_i*W_{i+1}/(W_i+W_{i+1}); document all width-transition nodes

Description: Schoof grounding-line flux parameterisation assumes marine ice sheet boundary conditions and may be inapplicable to land-terminating or narrow-fjord glaciers
Trigger_Condition: Glacier terminates on land or fjord width < 2 km
Likelihood: High — multiple Peninsula glaciers are land-terminating or narrow-fjord
Severity: High — Q_GL formula not valid; mass-budget error
Mitigation_Specified: For land-terminating glaciers: set Q_GL = W_GL * H_GL * u_GL (kinematic flux, no Schoof); for narrow fjords: apply width correction factor; flag all such cases
Mitigation_Status: Mitigation plan specified; individual glacier list not yet compiled

Description: Basal drag regularisation beta_b_reg may produce numerical stiffness when u -> u_reg (near-zero velocity)
Trigger_Condition: u near u_reg = 1e-4 m yr^-1 in cold slow-moving interior
Likelihood: Low — interior cells rarely reach u_reg
Severity: Medium — SSA matrix ill-conditioned near u_reg
Mitigation_Specified: Confirm that u_reg = 1e-4 m yr^-1 << typical ice velocities (1-1000 m yr^-1); choose epsilon_reg so regularised beta_b differs from unregularised beta_b by < 1% at u = 10 m yr^-1
Mitigation_Status: u_reg value confirmed in Phase 5.2.1 audit; residual stiffness not yet tested

Description: Passive-remainder diffusion approximation invalid for Graham Land spine glaciers
Trigger_Condition: Dynamic ratio > 30% (confirmed ANALYTICAL_ESTIMATE for Graham Land ~86.9%)
Likelihood: High — Graham Land spine is dynamically active
Severity: High — using passive approximation will under-predict retreat
Mitigation_Specified: Require SIA or SSA coupling for all Graham Land spine glaciers with dynamic ratio > 30%; specify sensitivity experiments EXP-PASSIVE-01 through EXP-PASSIVE-03
Mitigation_Status: Specified in Phase 5.2.2.3 and 5.2.2.4; not yet implemented

Description: Picard under-relaxation parameter omega not calibrated for Peninsula-specific viscosity contrasts
Trigger_Condition: omega outside [0.4, 0.6] required for convergence in some sectors
Severity: Medium — may require significant omega tuning
Mitigation_Specified: Specify omega sensitivity experiment EXP-PICARD-01 in Stage 1 calibration plan
Mitigation_Status: Experiment specified; omega range is provisional engineering estimate

Description: Grounding line migrates more than one full grid cell per timestep — multi-cell crossing — invalidating the retreat/advance bookkeeping algorithms
Trigger_Condition: v_GL > Delta_x / Delta_t = 500 m / 0.05 yr = 10,000 m yr^-1
Likelihood: Low for typical Peninsula dynamics; Medium for extreme collapse scenarios
Severity: High — g(n+1) - g(n) > 1 produces pointer ambiguity; retreat/advance algorithms fail
Mitigation_Specified: CFL-type timestep restriction: Delta_t <= Delta_x / |v_GL|_max. Dynamic timestep halving if violation detected. Hard error flag RSK_NUM_08 triggers timestep redo.
Mitigation_Status: Mitigation fully specified in Phase 5.2.2.7 CFL table

Description: All smoothing sensitivity statistics are ANALYTICAL_ESTIMATES derived from published aggregate flux values — not from cell-by-cell spatial raster computations
Trigger_Condition: Relied upon for spatial domain design or passive-assumption classification without raster verification
Likelihood: High — raster computation not yet performed
Severity: Medium-High — passive assumption could be incorrectly applied to Graham Land (confirmed INVALID) or Ipp-J (borderline) based on unverified estimates
Mitigation_Specified: Explicit ANALYTICAL_ESTIMATE labels on all smoothing statistics (Phase 5.2.2.7 smoothing_evidence_audit.csv). Stage 1 raster verification task specified. Prohibition on using these estimates to calibrate physical solver parameters.
Mitigation_Status: Labels applied; Stage 1 task specified in smoothing_evidence_audit.csv

Description: Floating reservoir initialisation at advance cells beyond BedMachine V4.1 spatial extent — ice thickness undefined for cells not covered by BedMachine data
Trigger_Condition: Advance crosses into grid cells at or beyond the data domain edge
Likelihood: Very Low — BedMachine V4.1 covers the full Antarctic Peninsula domain
Severity: Medium — advance algorithm requires H_{g+1}^n; if undefined then Delta_M_ground is undefined
Mitigation_Specified: Use H_{g+1} = 0 for cells beyond data extent (no floating ice assumed); flag RSK_DATA_02 and log the event. Verify that all 866,358 grounded cells are within BedMachine V4.1 spatial extent at Stage 1.
Mitigation_Status: Mitigation specified; BedMachine coverage not yet formally verified for all advance cells

Description: Lateral drag formula tau_wall = (5*u_bar / (A*W))^(1/n) assumes no-slip at lateral walls — may underestimate drag for partially-frozen fjord walls
Trigger_Condition: Ice-wall rheology differs from rock-wall assumption
Likelihood: Medium — mixed ice/rock walls occur at some fjords
Severity: Low-Medium — lateral drag slightly underestimated for ice-walled fjords
Mitigation_Specified: Document wall type for each flowline segment; apply rock-wall assumption as default; flag ice-walled fjords for sensitivity experiment
Mitigation_Status: Phase 5.2.2.5 derivation corrected factor-of-2 error; ice-wall sensitivity not yet quantified

Description: Schoof grounding-line flux assumes steady-state marine ice sheet and may not capture transient grounding-line dynamics accurately
Trigger_Condition: Rapid retreat with large H_GL gradient
Likelihood: Medium — transient conditions during rapid retreat
Severity: High — flux may be over- or under-estimated
Mitigation_Specified: Specify transient GL flux sensitivity experiment EXP-GL-01 in Stage 1; consider time-varying H_GL correction
Mitigation_Status: Experiment specified; transient correction not yet derived

Description: SSA adjustment timescale (20-50 yr) was revoked — actual SSA adjustment to geometry changes in 1D Peninsula flowlines is uncharacterised
Trigger_Condition: Any timestep; SSA is nonlocal and responds instantaneously in the diagnostic solver
Likelihood: High — SSA is solved as a steady BVP at each timestep
Severity: Medium — quasi-static assumption might miss important transient momentum adjustments
Mitigation_Specified: Formally revoked in Phase 5.2.2.6; Stage 1 EXP-ADJ-01 specified to characterise adjustment timescale empirically

Description: ISMIP6 calibration data used to adjust Pillar 1 physical parameters — violates project governance
Trigger_Condition: Any attempt to minimise discrepancy between Pillar 1 output and ISMIP6 by adjusting C_bed; A; n; or other physical parameters
Likelihood: Not applicable — this is a governance prohibition
Severity: Critical — would invalidate the hybrid architecture separation between Pillar 1 (physics) and Pillar 2 (ML calibration)
Mitigation_Specified: ISMIP6 is an EXTERNAL BENCHMARK ONLY. Never used to calibrate Pillar 1 physical parameters. All calibration uses observational data (IMBIE3; BedMachine; ITS_LIVE velocities).
Mitigation_Status: Prohibition stated in every phase report
